content: A pathaipaw hringzia phunglang sahlo
Mataico, Khri khatah hringnah lang patho naa cang thah cawtah Khazing cacang lang letei Khri a tynah hming sahlo lekhei naa lung paria thlang my lo.
Aluicung hming sahlo lekhei cang lytah vaicung lang hming sahlo lekhei naa lung paria thlang my lo.
Zemaw tah pawco, a suapaw naa mehring cangnah cawh thi thah ka, atoheh cawh naa hringnah cawh Khri khatah Khazing letah nopaw a cang myca.
Naa thlawpaw hringnah hmuisui a cangpaw Khri a va lang tihtah naaning zong rungnawnah chitah Ama khatah na lang hrah he ceh.
Macawtaco aluicung naa suapa dunah a cangpaw, canu capaw suanah, pathailynah, hohenah, sua dunah thinglung le nono behnah a cangpaw hangkynah sahlo khah theh my lo.
Zecawtamaw tatah ma sahlo rawng tahei Khazing tah a thingaenah cawh a sah pui tah a palang a.
Khuahlai tei naa hringzia leco, ma sahlo heh naa za tua tei.
Canghrasala atoheh cawh ma hapaw hming a cangpaw, thingaenah, ingthonah, ziahnuinah, male thai pachianah le hmokaw taitah biachia papia lai tahpaw sahlo heh cawh naa hly hrahring a.
Naa cangnah a paringpaw khah a tua teipaw khakhei naa pahluhly thah cawtah pakheh le pakheh a dungkhei khe lo.
Atoheh cawh Tuatu Khazing hmuisang hninah letah patha leimeipaw cang he ceh ka, naa mehring cangnah a thapaw khah naa hrei thah he ceh kho.

Ma hringnah tha leco Grik cawngsaw le Juda cawngsaw, cingpa a taipaw le a tai lypaw, mehpiachong, Sithia mehchiahru cawngsaw, sae le a zalongpaw tah ung lytah Khri cawh zezongpui cang ka, naa zongmingtei chung letah a ung kho.
Macawtaco Khazing tah ca thing he ka, a pathaipaw le do hmuisuipaw tah a ca tua he. Macawtaco, zawngrawhnah, ningdonah, a panynah, ningnainah le lungsynah sahlo khah a hrei my lo.
Pakheh le pakheh raidawnah hnui la, pakheh kheh tah naa thing a ca aesah caco he a ngethai my lo. Abuipaw tei a ca ngethai pawhe hrakhei a ngethai my lo.
Taico, ma hming vytei cung lekhei donah khah chahchi la, donah cawh zezong maikaw tlangtling teitah a pakongtu a cang.
Pungkheh letei cawngsaw naa cang cawtah a dorai teitah ung pawtah y naa cangpaw hrakhei Khri thlawlungnah takhei naa lungthing cawh uh my seh lo. Taico a lawng paria thlang my lo.

Khri a bia cawh naa chung letah a hlupui tah ung ky seh. Pakheh le pakheh khah singnah vytei khakhei a chinghring la, a cawngpah my lo. Reithainah hlaw, Khazing behnah hlaw, thlawpaw lang hlaw naa sah ning takhei Khazing khatah a lawng hmotah sah my lo.
Taico bia tamaw, raihrená tamaw, hming naa tuapaw maikaw cawh Abuipaw Zisu ming tah tua thlu la, Ama a thong co Paw Khazing kha lawngbia a hlai paria my lo.
Khrisaw ingchungkho cawtah phunglang
Naaning nupui a cangpaw sahlo, naa pasae leh aa bia khah nge my lo, ma heh Abuipaw a zuipaw cawngsaw tei tua rua pawtah a tlahpaw cawh a cang hi.
Naaning pasae a cangpaw sahlo, naa nupui leh khah do la, hrehro simi khe lo.
Naaning sawtei a cangpaw sahlo, zezongpui kong lekhei naa no naa paw rei khah nge my lo. Ma taco Abuipaw cawh a lawngsah kho.
Naaning Paw a cangpaw sahlo, naa sawtei leh khah a hnasah khe lo, aa lungdong sua le.

Naaning sae a cangpaw sahlo, hming maikaw letah alui letei naa bui leh aa rei khah nge my lo. Ma cawh aa mehmuh letah aa lung tong du caw longlong tah cang lytah lungtho teitah le Abuipaw naa cizawnah cawtah cang hri my seh lo.
Zehming naa tua hmai tah mehnung cawtah tua bei peh, Abuipaw a cawtah kaa tua tahpaw lung hnui la, naa lung hmuisui tah tua my lo.
Zemaw tah pawco, Abuipaw taitah longmai hratah ry cypaw kaa hmuh a tah naa hni thlang kho. Abuipaw Khri a rai naa hrepah leimeipaw cawh Ama heh a cang hi.
Ahohmai hmingchahly a tuapaw cawh hmingchahly a tuapaw hrakhei hreh a cang a. Abuipaw tah patlia patlanah ung lytah bia a ce a.
